svg.aria-label: IN: Who are you? OUT: A builder from India who likes to understand what happens underneath. I write C when I want to see the machine, and I wire up sensors when I want to see the physics. IN: What are you working on? OUT: ForgeShell, a Unix shell with a field guide that explains every line, and a rocket that steers by tilting its motor.
